event_name: Date 12 May 2018 Time 16:24 2018 SPANISH GRAND PRIX 10 - 13 May 2018 The Stewards have received a request from Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda to allow car 28 to start the race despite not setting a time in qualifying. In accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 28, Brendon Hartley, to start the race as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event.
rules_referenced: Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: 2018 Spanish Grand Prix 2018 Decision Car 28 Failure To Set A Time In Qualifying Doc 24
